ExternalFixture.lean:
module
namespace ExternalFixture
public axiom forbidden : False
private theorem hidden : False := forbidden
public opaque relay : False := hidden
public theorem forwarded : False := relay
end ExternalFixture
ExternalFixtureGood.lean:
module
namespace ExternalFixtureGood
private theorem hidden : True := True.intro
public opaque relay : True := hidden
public noncomputable def chosen : Nat :=
  Classical.choice (show Nonempty Nat from ⟨0⟩)
public theorem extensional (P Q : Prop) (h : P ↔ Q) : P = Q := propext h
public theorem quotient {α : Sort u} {r : α → α → Prop}
    (a b : α) (h : r a b) : Quot.mk r a = Quot.mk r b := Quot.sound h
end ExternalFixtureGood

BuildingBlocks/ExportedGood.lean:
module
public import ExternalFixtureGood
namespace BuildingBlocks.ExportedGood
public noncomputable def chosen : Nat := ExternalFixtureGood.chosen
public theorem extensional (P Q : Prop) (h : P ↔ Q) : P = Q :=
  ExternalFixtureGood.extensional P Q h
public theorem quotient {α : Sort u} {r : α → α → Prop}
    (a b : α) (h : r a b) : Quot.mk r a = Quot.mk r b :=
  ExternalFixtureGood.quotient a b h
public theorem throughOpaque : True := ExternalFixtureGood.relay
public theorem natReflexive (n : Nat) : n = n :=
  Nat.rec (motive := fun n => n = n) rfl (fun _ _ => rfl) n
end BuildingBlocks.ExportedGood
namespace OutsideNamespace
public theorem extra : True := True.intro
end OutsideNamespace
